name: Mozambique
famous_for: Bazaruto Archipelago marine reserve (dolphins & dugongs), colonial Ilha de Moçambique, peri-peri prawns, and Marrabenta music.
tourists: Over 1.5M visitors; famous for Bazaruto sand dunes, Tofo whale shark diving, and Gorongosa National Park wildlife revival.
must_know: Ilha de Moçambique was a major Portuguese trading hub on the spice route for 400 years and holds the oldest European building in the south hemisphere.
fun_fact: The marine waters of Bazaruto Archipelago protect the last viable population of endangered dugongs in the Western Indian Ocean.
